info.title: fuaran-core-idl — the IDL stability classifier over two `idl.json` revisions.
info.description: Fuaran.Core.Idl.Cli — the IDL stability classifier as a command (`fuaran-core-idl`). Classifies the delta between two `idl.json` revisions: the wire severity per changed member with the reason it applies, the wire-profile evolution, and the F# consequence classes a consumer compiled against the generated structural layer meets. Exits 0 / 3 / 4 for absorbable / breaking / undecided, or asserts a declared class with `--expect`. .NET-only and build-time; the classification it prints lives in Fuaran.Core.Idl.Codegen.

options.name: --manifest
options.description:
the conformance corpus manifest, read ONLY for its host roster.
Omitted, the declared roster is used and the report says so.

options.name: --expect
options.description:
assert the verdict class. Exits 0 on a match, 1 on a mismatch.
One of: unchanged | host-surface | additive | breaking | undecided
